meta.title: Privacy Policy
meta.description: How Pedra Norte processes personal data collected through this website, under the GDPR.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.notice: Provisional text. It must be reviewed by a legal professional before final publication.

sections.heading: Data controller
paragraphs: The controller of personal data collected on this website is {legalEntity}, owner of the Pedra Norte brand, with registered office at {address}. You can contact us at {email}.

sections.heading: Data collected and purpose
paragraphs: Through the quote request form we collect your name, email and, if provided, phone number, type of work and message. We use this data solely to reply to your request and prepare a proposal.
The legal basis is your consent and pre-contractual steps taken at your request (Article 6(1)(a) and (b) GDPR).

sections.heading: Retention and sharing
paragraphs: We keep the data only for as long as needed to reply to your request and, if a contract follows, for the applicable legal periods. We do not sell or share data with third parties.
The form is sent using the Postmark transactional email service, which acts as a processor.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You may at any time request access to, rectification, erasure or portability of your data, object to processing or withdraw consent by writing to {email}.
You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Portuguese Data Protection Authority, CNPD (www.cnpd.pt).

terms.notice: Provisional text. It must be reviewed by a legal professional before final publication.

sections.heading: Identification
paragraphs: This website is owned by {legalEntity}, owner of the Pedra Norte brand, with registered office at {address}.

sections.heading: Content
paragraphs: The content of this website is for information only. Project images labelled “sample project” are illustrative and do not show work carried out by Pedra Norte.
Quote requests sent through the website do not constitute a contract. Any work is subject to its own quote and written agreement.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
paragraphs: The brand, logo and texts on this website belong to {legalEntity} and may not be reproduced without permission.

sections.heading: Dispute resolution
paragraphs: In the event of a consumer dispute, consumers may use an alternative dispute resolution body. More information is available on the Portuguese Consumer Portal (www.consumidor.gov.pt). An electronic Complaints Book is also available.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.notice: Provisional text. It must be reviewed by a legal professional before final publication.

sections.heading: Which cookies we use
paragraphs: This website does not use analytics, advertising or social media cookies. Only cookies strictly necessary for the technical operation of the site may be used, and these do not require consent.
If analytics tools are added in the future, this policy will be updated and your prior consent will be requested.

sections.heading: Managing cookies
paragraphs: You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings. Blocking strictly necessary cookies may affect how the site works.
